artifact_of_record: The committed bundle bytes and packet.json are the artifact of record; their own content_sha256/packet_content_sha256 are stable file hashes (re-hashing the committed file always yields the published value).
scope_finding: A from-source rebuild via apply_adopted_config(source_bundle) is NOT byte-identical across numeric environments: query_similarity drifts at ~1e-4..1e-3 because TF-IDF/SVD is float- and reduction-order sensitive, and for fr/de that drift reassigns cluster_id on a large fraction of rows. This is the documented BLAS-reduction-order class (frontier-served-packet-falsification FIX-2), NOT data tampering and NOT a change to any frozen rule. The frozen 11-criteria geometry rule runs on the COMMITTED bytes, whose hash is stable; a recomputation in a different environment may legitimately differ.

environment_of_generation_and_measuremen.note: BLAS build / thread count / CPU are NOT pinned in the artifact; pin them before asserting cross-machine byte-identity.

remediation_for_future_scoring: pin and record BLAS build + thread count alongside any reproducibility sha, or

round query_similarity to a fixed precision before clustering if cross-env stability of cluster_id is required (NOT done here: it would change the committed bytes and the frozen-scored layout, which is ceded to Evaluation).
